value.rationale: The sign reversal is a sharp structural paradox in a natural measurable voter-model functional: faster hub activity reduces immediate edge disagreement yet increases total integrated discord on all stars of degree at least four. The universal discount boundary alpha(k-3), degree-three exact invariance, and full all-degree classification permit cross-time-scale comparisons and benchmark network intervention dynamics. Not just routine parameter substitution or a finite table. No claim of practical direct social-policy advice.
